data.body:
Correction to the immediately preceding shell-stripped comment; this entry is authoritative.

RP-01 Phase-4 research is complete and the one-at-a-time decision queue is fixed. Canonical brief: `.joe-janitor/rp01-pydantic-native-research.md`. Executable probes: `.joe-janitor/rp01-pydantic-native-probe.py`, `.joe-janitor/rp01-cache-live-probe.py`, and `.joe-janitor/rp01-usage-compat-probe.py`. Recovery authority: `irascible-clueless-basenji` (`ee98-a2c0-7d12-4c75`). No production or tracked file changed.

Already approved: one operation-wide Pydantic request budget with a documented raise-the-limit follow-up if legitimate recovery is starved; complete failed response on retry only when deterministic fit is proven, otherwise omit it whole; no truncation of authoritative input, output, or stored history; bounded length/max_tokens retry with the approved concise-response guidance; refusal/content-filter remains terminal.

Three maintainer decisions remain, in order: (1) aggregate every successful retry attempt into the single operation usage and telemetry row; (2) on exhaustion, re-raise only the exact Rebar-owned output error found in the Pydantic cause chain and never blanket-translate `UnexpectedModelBehavior`; (3) preserve Pydantic `requests` and add `candidate_requests` for logical fallback and downgrade candidate calls observed through public `WrapperModel`. The compatibility audit found no accepted-attempt-only consumer and proved `candidate_requests` currently drops at four explicit allowlists that the story must update. This ticket remains `in_progress` through those approvals; implementation ticketization is still gated.
